integrity: The proof uses the published exact rank-one q-numerical-radius formula and elementary symbolic optimization; no numerical experiment is used as proof. Literature searches did not identify a covering statement, with residual risk from older equivalent terminology.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only nonzero rank-one operators. It does not determine higher-rank norm envelopes or improve the universal dilation constant.
title: Exact rank-one norm profile under scaled \(q\)-numerical disk containment
